reason: The cited evidence supports that CrMnFeCoNi suffers from non-protective oxidation and Mn depletion (E1, E2), and that Y2O3 additions can act as oxygen scavengers and grain refiners in a different HEA system (E3). However, no cited evidence demonstrates that yttrium addition to CrMnFeCoNi actually reduces Mn depletion or improves oxide scale uniformity and adhesion; the mechanism is extrapolated from a different alloy and oxide form.
premises: CrMnFeCoNi forms non-protective oxides with Mn depletion during high-temperature oxidation
Mn depletion degrades mechanical properties of CrMnFeCoNi
Yttrium (or Y2O3) acts as an oxygen scavenger and grain refiner in HEAs
Yttrium addition can promote a more uniform and adherent oxide scale
Yttrium-rich oxide dispersions anchor and refine the oxide scale, reducing Mn oxidation
